command: set -euo pipefail; adb shell am force-stop link.localclimate.app; adb logcat -c; adb shell am start -W -n link.localclimate.app/.MainActivity; sleep 2; adb shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/lcl-ux.xml >/dev/null; mkdir -p /tmp/lcl-ux-v139; adb pull /sdcard/lcl-ux.xml /tmp/lcl-ux-v139/window.xml >/dev/null; adb exec-out screencap -p > /tmp/lcl-ux-v139/screen.png; sips -Z 480 -s format jpeg -s formatOptions 55 /tmp/lcl-ux-v139/screen.png --out /tmp/lcl-ux-v139/screen.jpg >/dev/null; base64 < /tmp/lcl-ux-v139/screen.jpg | tr -d '\n' > /tmp/lcl-ux-v139/screen.jpg.b64; echo '=== UI TEXT ==='; sed -E 's/></>\n</g' /tmp/lcl-ux-v139/window.xml | grep -E 'text=|content-desc=' | head -n 120; echo '=== ACTIVITY ==='; adb shell dumpsys activity activities | grep -m 1 'link.localclimate.app/.MainActivity'; echo '=== SCREEN ==='; sips -g pixelWidth -g pixelHeight /tmp/lcl-ux-v139/screen.jpg; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
